_how: Every item that can be found on the site. The key (e.g. "test_token") is the item's id: use it in data-item="..." on a page, in a frequency code's {"type": "item", "id": "..."} action, or in Marquez's "give". Fields: name (shown on the found slip and in the drawer), desc (shown when you hover it in the drawer; \n for a new line), art (an image, ideally a transparent SVG or PNG under /backstage/drawer/art/), size (how big it lies in the drawer: 1 is normal, 0.7 small, 1.4 large), found (optional: the small line on the found slip, default "into the drawer"). Items not listed here still go in the drawer, as a plain paper tag with their id.
